summary: Certified collections notices: collection_notice_templates (each community's current Vantaca wording seeded as a DRAFT with five counsel questions and seven required elements), collection_notice_batches (workpaper) and collection_notices (association_record: fixed statement snapshot, PDF, USPS tracking, mailing evidence, fee links). Database-enforced controls: cure period >= 45 days, deadline = notice date + cure, amount due = ledger + fee, mailed only with a tracking number on the notice date, one open notice per account. Fee idempotency keys (one homeowner fee row, one GL entry, one Bedrock billing item per notice). communities.collection_fee_autopost added DEFAULT false (no homeowner fee is charged until the owner turns it on). billing_pending_items.source also allows collection_notice. Creates no journal entry, ledger row, charge or balance.

preflight.name: dependent tables exist (communities, properties, ownership_tenures, homeowner_transactions, journal_entries, billing_pending_items)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('communities','properties','ownership_tenures','homeowner_transactions','journal_entries','billing_pending_items')

preflight.name: collections tables not created yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('collection_notice_templates','collection_notice_batches','collection_notices')

preflight.name: communities.collection_fee_autopost not added yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'communities' AND column_name = 'collection_fee_autopost'

preflight.name: communities that will receive a draft template: 13 in production
every existing billing item uses an allowed source (manual / email), so the widened check validates
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM billing_pending_items WHERE source NOT IN ('manual','email')

preflight.name: no ledger row already claims to be a collections notice fee
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE raw_row_jsonb->>'source' = 'collection_notice_fee'

preflight.name: no journal entry already uses a collections notice reference
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entries WHERE source_reference LIKE 'collnotice:%'

expected_changes: communities gains collection_fee_autopost boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (every community reads false: no homeowner fee).
New tables collection_notice_templates (mixed), collection_notice_batches (workpaper), collection_notices (association_record); RLS on, service_role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only.
collection_notice_templates: +13 rows, one DRAFT per community (status draft, counsel_status questions_open). Nothing can be approved for mailing until the owner approves a template.

Unique keys: one approved template per community; one open notice per account; a USPS tracking number once; one homeowner fee row (homeowner_transactions expression index), one GL entry (journal_entries collnotice: reference) and one Bedrock billing item (billing_pending_items) per notice.
billing_pending_items source check also allows collection_notice; existing items unchanged.

verify.name: the three tables exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('collection_notice_templates','collection_notice_batches','collection_notices')

verify.name: one draft template per community, counsel questions open
verify.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM collection_notice_templates WHERE status = 'draft' AND counsel_status = 'questions_open' AND jsonb_array_length(counsel_questions) = 5) = (SELECT count(*) FROM communities) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM collection_notice_templates WHERE status <> 'draft') = 0

verify.name: no homeowner fee is on (collection_fee_autopost false everywhere)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE collection_fee_autopost

verify.name: notice controls exist: cure >= 45 (templates and notices), deadline / amount / mailed checks
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid WHERE c.relname IN ('collection_notices','collection_notice_templates') AND k.contype = 'c' AND (pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) LIKE '%cure_days >= 45%' OR pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) LIKE '%deadline_date >= (notice_date + cure_days)%' OR pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) LIKE '%amount_due_cents = (ledger_balance_cents + fee_cents)%' OR pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) LIKE '%mailed_date = notice_date%')

verify.name: unique keys exist (open notice, tracking, approved template, fee row, GL reference, billing item)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexname IN ('uq_collection_notice_open','uq_collection_notice_tracking','uq_collection_template_approved','uq_homeowner_txn_collection_notice_fee','uq_journal_entries_collection_notice','uq_billing_pending_collection_notice')

verify.name: billing_pending_items source check allows collection_notice and the existing sources
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'billing_pending_items_source_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%collection_notice%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%manual%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%email%'

verify.name: service_role can write the notices; anon cannot read them
verify.sql: SELECT (has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.collection_notices', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.collection_notices', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.collection_notice_templates', 'UPDATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.collection_notice_templates', 'SELECT'))::int
